style: Elegant cinematic space art, a clean high-resolution digital matte painting, soft volumetric nebula, crisp tiny stars, calm and majestic.
scene: A very wide panoramic view of deep space: a long soft nebula band sweeps diagonally across the whole width from the lower left to the upper right, a large ringed gas giant planet sits near the right end of the panorama, lit from the left, its thin rings tilted, a small moon beside it, the left part of the panorama is calm open space with scattered fine stars. No spaceships, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
light: Colours: a bright pale space like a luminous dawn sky, soft mint and pale teal nebula with warm copper #e8874f and peach glow, the planet in petrol teal #086875 with copper rings, airy and light.
dark: Colours: deep black space, the nebula glowing petrol teal #086875 and cyan with warm copper #e8874f and amber highlights, the planet dark petrol with a thin copper-lit crescent and glowing copper rings, many fine stars.
